worker.scientific_authority: No Astra scientific authority or independent-review claim

same_physics.source: Unchanged parent ElectronSource; proton birth support 1-4 MeV, selected electron energy 0.1-900 eV, Q_e(W,t)=t A(W), initially empty, T=1e10 s.
same_physics.bath: Exactly inherited nH=140 m^-3, YHe=.248, xHII=xHeII=.01, xHeIII=0, Tgas=100 K prescribed bath; no feedback.
same_physics.transport: Reuse hash-checked parent Cascade unchanged, including classical/quantum Coulomb min closure with quantum_constant=0, projection, source quadrature, time propagator, and ledgers.
same_physics.excitation: Exactly the same 27 checked CCC raw tables and native first-zero effective costs, linear interpolation, native zero rows, no extrapolation. Their spectroscopic/Hamiltonian interpretation is separately audited; no relabeling or energy-axis shift in this comparison.
same_physics.ionization_daughters: W and E-B-W, 0<=W<=(E-B)/2; one extra electron, binding energy B retained separately.
same_physics.atomic_change_only: Replace AtomicData.ionization objects with compatible full-BED ionization objects. Parent science files must not be edited.

paired_delta_diagnostic: For each nonzero paired delta Delta, report r=abs(Delta_fine-Delta_coarse)/abs(Delta_fine). Empirically resolved iff r<1/3 and signs agree. This is a two-grid diagnostic, not a certified error bound or significance test; unresolved rows remain unresolved.

resources.self_contained: Bundle NCP start prompt, frozen contract, code, all parent source/raw inputs and saved comparison evidence, source citations, dependency specification, resource admission, exact commands and return collector. No additional user attachment required.
resources.next_bounded_task: Conditional paired third-grid refinement at (3200,6400), full BED and legacy BEQ/BED sequentially, matched against saved4800 results, only if next DAG admits this numerical task. Exact same physics/precision/tolerances. No64-rank sweep.
resources.hardware: Advertised64CPU128GB is context only. Detect actual affinity/quota, RAM, free disk and live load; one process with thread1 by default, reserve12.5% minimum1GiB. Do not assume remote credentials from ChatGPT connector access.
resources.publication: Collect actual results and typed checks, then request independent Astra decision. Do not auto-promote global gates or edit production. Preserve dirty work and use isolated extraction/worktree.

one_authorized_repair: One targeted contract-preserving implementation/interface/shape bug or quadrature-order increase up to256 if an unchanged atomic integral tolerance fails; retain first run. No physical coefficient, energy cost, cutoff, tolerance or grid change. Anything beyond returns to Astra.
admission: state/NEXT_DAG.json task READY, exact contract SHA, unchanged inherited_gates, hash-bound review decision PASS_SCOPED/PROMOTE_SCOPED with both independence booleans true
readback: ordinary immutable backup upload R1; downloaded restore R3 actual archive/full inner hashes
